workflows.scenario: View checking account activity from the simulator home page

steps.action: Navigate to the simulator landing page
steps.expected: Landing page loads with GET STARTED NOW button visible

steps.action: Click GET STARTED NOW to enter the simulator
steps.expected: The simulator dashboard URL loads and welcome dialog appears

steps.action: Dismiss the welcome dialog by clicking Ok
steps.expected: Welcome dialog closes and dashboard is fully visible

steps.action: Verify the dashboard shows Checking and Saving account cards
steps.expected: Both account card headers are visible on the dashboard

steps.action: Click VIEW ACCOUNT on the Checking account card
Verify the Account Activity page loaded correctly
steps.expected: Page heading, SELECT ACCOUNT section, Checking/Saving tabs, and transaction table are all visible

steps.action: Confirm the seeded Account Opening transaction is present in the table
steps.expected: Account Opening row is visible in the transaction table

workflows.test: tests/account-activity.spec.ts#view checking account activity from the simulator home page
